description: This file defines the class Base64VLQ, which implements encoding and decoding of VLQ (Variable Length Quantity) values in Base64 encoding, used for source map generation in SCSSPHP. It includes methods for encoding integers to VLQ Base64 strings and decoding such strings back to integers.

classes.name: Base64VLQ
classes.description: A class implementing Base64 VLQ encoding and decoding as used in source map generation for SCSSPHP.

methods.name: encode
methods.description: Encodes an integer value into a VLQ Base64 string.

methods.name: decode
methods.description: Decodes a VLQ Base64 string back into an integer value.

methods.name: toVLQSigned
methods.description: Converts a signed integer to a VLQ signed format (to handle negative values).

methods.name: fromVLQSigned
methods.description: Converts from VLQ signed format back to a signed integer.
